_template: Manifest template — scripts/package.sh emits the resolved copy: embedded inside both artifacts (artifacts: null there; an artifact cannot contain its own digest) and standalone at artifacts/pack.json (fully resolved, attached to the release).
name: skia-pack
_macos_fields: Top-level gn_args_* and toolchain describe the macOS slice (the shape of every earlier release); all platforms are detailed under slices.
gn_args_sha256: <sha256 of gn/macos.gn, resolved at package time>
deps_externals: <skia DEPS externals commit map, recorded post git-sync-deps>
slices: <per-slice provenance: origin (reused|built), gn args file + sha256, deployment target, toolchain, archs, libSkiaPack_sha256; a reused slice also names the release it came from>
